item.title: Stafford edges Maye for NFL MVP
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Matthew Stafford edged Drake Maye for the AP NFL Most Valuable Player award on Thursday night in the closest race since Peyton Manning and Steve McNair were co-winners in 2003. Stafford received 24 of 50 first-place votes while Maye got 23. But Maye has a chance to go home this week […]

item.title: Review: Katie Chin celebrates her mom Leeann Chin in sweet, savory and delightful show
item.description: If nothing else, locals who see “Holy Shiitake!” have probably heard of Chin's mom, Leeann Chin. She built a restaurant empire, sold it for millions, took it back over and eventually retired and reconnected with Katie.

item.title: Fitzgerald, Brees headline NFL Hall of Fame class
item.description: Drew Brees and Larry Fitzgerald headlined the 2026 Pro Football Hall of Fame class featuring five players but not six-time Super Bowl winning head coach Bill Belichick.

item.title: Farmington Mayor abruptly resigns after expletives fly at city council meeting
item.description: Farmington Mayor Joshua Hoyt resigned Wednesday after heated Monday city council meeting.
